entries.content:
### Scene
Mirror selfie in an otaku-style computer corner, blue color tone.

### Subject
* Gender expression: female
* Age: around 25
* Ethnicity: East Asian
* Body type: slim, with a defined waist; natural body proportions
* Skin tone: light neutral tone
* Hairstyle:
    * Length: waist-length hair
    * Style: straight with slightly curled ends
    * Color: medium brown
* Pose:
    * Stance: standing in a slight contrapposto pose
    * Right hand: holding a smartphone in front of her face (identity hidden)
    * Left arm: naturally hanging down alongside the torso
    * Torso: body leaning slightly back; waist and abdomen exposed
* Clothing:
    * Top: light blue cropped knit cardigan, top two buttons fastened; a blue French-style bra faintly visible
    * Bottom: denim ultra-short shorts, with a blue satin ribbon bow on each side of the hips
    * Socks: blue and white horizontal striped over-the-knee socks
    * Accessory: a blue cute mascot phone case

### Environment
* Description: bedroom computer corner seen through a wall-mounted mirror
* Furnishings:
    * White desk
    * Single monitor showing a soft blue wallpaper (no readable text)
    * Mechanical keyboard with white keycaps on a blue desk mat
    * Mouse on a small blue mouse pad
    * PC tower on the right side with blue case lighting
    * Three anime figures on or near the PC tower
    * A poster of a pagoda on the wall
    * Cat-shaped desk lamp with blue accents
    * A transparent glass of water
    * A tall green leafy plant by the window (on the left side of the frame)
* Color replacement: replace all originally pink elements (clothes and room decor) with blue tones (baby blue to sky blue/periwinkle blue).

### Lighting
* Light source: daylight coming from a large window on the left side of the camera, through sheer curtains
* Light quality: soft, diffused light
* White balance (K): 5200

### Camera
* Mode: smartphone rear camera shooting via the mirror (no portrait/bokeh mode)
* Equivalent focal length (mm): 26
* Distances (m):
    * Subject to mirror: 0.6
    * Camera to mirror: 0.5
* Exposure:
    * Aperture (f): 1.8
    * ISO: 100
    * Shutter speed (s): 0.01
    * Exposure compensation (EV): -0.3
* Focus: focus on the torso and shorts in the mirror image
* Depth of field: natural smartphone deep depth of field; background clearly visible with no artificial blur
* Composition:
    * Aspect ratio: 1:1
    * Crop: from the top of the head to mid-thigh; include the desk, monitor, PC tower, and plant in the frame
    * Angle: slightly high angle from the mirror’s point of view
    * Composition note: keep the subject centered; to avoid wide-angle edge distortion, have her stand a bit further away and crop to a square later.

### Negative prompts
* Any appearance of pink/magenta anywhere
* Beauty filters/over-smoothed skin; poreless skin look
* Exaggerated or distorted anatomy
* NSFW, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunctions
* Logos, brand names, or readable user interface text
* Fake portrait-mode blur, CGI/illustration feel

entries.content:
Input Variable: [insert product name]
Language: [insert language]

System Instruction:
Create an image of premium liquid glass Bento grid product infographic with 8 modules (card 2 to 8 show text titles only).
1) Product Analysis:
→ Identify product's dominant natural color → "hero color"
→ Identify category: FOOD / MEDICINE / TECH
2) Color Palette (derived from hero):
→ Product + accents: full saturation hero color
→ Icons, borders: muted hero (30-40% saturation, never black)
3) Visual Style:
→ Hero product: real photography (authentic, premium), 3D Glass version [choose one]
→ Cards: Apple liquid glass (85-90% transparent) with Whisper-thin borders and Subtle drop shadow for floating depth and reflecting the background color
→ Background stays behind cards and high blur where cards are [choose one]:
  - Ethereal: product essence, light caustics, abstract glow
  - Macro: product texture close-up, heavily blurred
  - Pattern: product repeated softly at 10-15% opacity
  - Context: relevant environment, blurred + desaturated
→ Add subtle motion effect
→ Asymmetric Bento grid, 16:9 landscape
→ Hero card: 28-30% | Info modules: 70-72%
4) Module Content (8 Cards):
M1 — Hero: Product displayed as real photo / 3D glass / stylized interpretation (choose one)in beautiful form + product name label
M2 — Core Benefits: 4 unique benefits + hero-color icons
M3 — How to Use: 4 usage methods + icons
M4 — Key Metrics: 5 EXACT data points
Format: [icon] [Label] [Bold Value] [Unit]
FOOD: Calories: [X] kcal/100g, Carbs: [X]g (fiber [X]g, sugar [X]g), Protein: [X]g, [Key Vitamin]: [X]mg ([X]% DV), [Key Mineral]: [X]mg ([X]% DV)
MEDICINE:Active: [name], Strength: [X] mg, Onset: [X] min, Duration: [X] hrs, Half-life: [X] hrs 
TECH:Chip: [model], Battery: [X] hrs, Weight: [X]g,[Key spec]: [value], Connectivity: [protocols]
M5 — Who It's For: 4 recommended groups with green checkmark icons | 3 caution groups with amber warning icons
M6 — Important Notes: 4 precautions + warning icons
M7 — Quick Reference:
→ FOOD: Glycemic Index + dietary tags with icons
→ MEDICINE: Side effects + severity with icons
→ TECH: Compatibility + certifications with icons
M8 — Did You Know: 3 facts (origin, science, global stat) + icons
Output: 1 image, 16:9 landscape, ultra-premium liquid glass infographic.

Theme:
A vertical three-panel fashion narrative depicting high-society relaxation in a minimalist Soho penthouse.

Subject:
{argument name="name" default="Elena"}, a {argument name="age" default="21"}-year-old Caucasian woman with a lean, athletic build. She appears in a sequence of three frames: a wide architectural view, a direct eye-level portrait, and a tactile close-up of her hand resting on her hip.

Person · Expression:
Heart-shaped face with a clean-girl aesthetic, featuring feathered brows and high-gloss lips. Her gaze is enigmatic and half-lidded, with detailed irises reflecting the Manhattan skyline. Her honey-blonde hair is styled in tousled, "just-woke-up" waves that catch the golden hour backlight. Skin is dewy and luminous with realistic micro-textures, including visible pores and soft downy hair.

Clothing · Pose:
She wears an onyx black Chantilly lace couture bodysuit with intricate floral motifs, contrasted against oversized, heavily washed vintage indigo denim worn loosely at the hips. Her wrist, adorned with stacked gold Cartier Love bracelets and a Juste un Clou ring, rests against the rugged denim to showcase the interplay between fine jewelry and fabric.

Background · Light:
An ultra-exclusive Soho penthouse with floor-to-ceiling windows and minimalist decor, including a white high-pile carpet and a soft cotton duvet. The scene is illuminated by warm, directional golden hour sunlight creating sharp, geometric shadows and ray-traced highlights on skin and gold accessories.

Composition · Camera:
A vertical 3-panel collage. The top panel uses a wide-angle perspective for the setting; the middle panel is a shallow-depth-of-field portrait; the bottom panel is a macro-focused shot of textures. Captured with a Phase One XF IQ4 and an 80mm Schneider Kreuznach lens.

Texture · Style:
Hyper-realistic high-fashion editorial style. Tactile rendering of delicate lace, heavy denim, and polished gold. The image features a high-contrast S-curve color grade, subtle film grain, and a soft bloom on the highlight edges of the lace.

A Japanese Edo-period Ukiyo-e woodblock print. The overall feeling is a surreal collaboration between masters like Hokusai and Hiroshige, reimagining modern technology through an ancient lens.

**The scene:** {argument name="modern scene" default="a busy Shibuya scramble crossing"}

**Edo transformation logic:**
Characters wear Edo-era kimono but perform modern actions. All technology is transformed into surreal Edo equivalents:
* Smartphones are glowing, illustrated paper scrolls being read intently.
* Metro stations and trains are giant articulated wooden centipede carriages shuffling through crowds.
* Skyscrapers are reimagined as endless, towering wooden pagodas reaching into dramatic clouds.
* Robots and mecha appear as giant, armored woodblock golems.

The composition uses a flattened perspective with large, bold, hand-carved ink outlines. The background features heavily stylized Ukiyo-e wave patterns and dramatic, swirling clouds, with a distant Mt. Fuji visible on the horizon.

The image must look like a physical print, not a digital painting.
* Texture: strong visible wood grain texture and rough paper fibers throughout the piece.
* Printing imperfections: pigment bleeding is evident. Simulate hand-pressed plates with slight color misalignment for authenticity.
* Color palette: strictly limited to traditional mineral pigments, with dominant use of Prussian blue, vermilion red, and muted yellow ochre.
* Lighting: soft, flat, shadow-free lighting with no digital gradients.

Aspect ratio is 3:4 vertical poster. Include vertical Japanese calligraphy describing the scene and a traditional red artist seal stamp in a corner.

The model wears the same cohesive black-and-white set in every panel: black halter sport bra with white elastic band reading "{argument name="brand" default="KUMORA ACTIVE"}", wide black track pants with twin white side stripes, oversized cropped black shell jacket with subtle mesh panels and small white label, black curved-brim cap with tiny white K mark, and silver on-ear sport headset with circular earcups. Outfit, cap, headset, and identity stay fully consistent; only pose and jacket position change.

Expressions are calm, focused, and editorial: side glance in portrait, active standing pose, quiet direct crouch, wind-swept profile in the jacket-lift crop. Keep the headset visible in every frame. Use soft high-key studio lighting from the front upper left with gentle fill and subtle contact shadows only where needed. White background is the dominant field; black garments form the graphic structure; white trims and stripes create rhythm; the silver headset is the product highlight. Preserve detail in black fabrics: matte stretch bra, ribbed elastic band, white piping, nylon jacket sheen, mesh texture, cap stitching, woven label, and clean metal earcups.

Exact visible text only: small "{argument name="brand" default="KUMORA ACTIVE"}" near the top of each panel, and bold bottom-center title "{argument name="product" default="STUDIO MOTION SET"}" in black uppercase sans serif. No extra copy.

entries.content:
Theme:
1920s Art-Deco opulence and high-society elegance at twilight.

Subject:
A Caucasian woman in her late twenties with a slender, graceful build, standing alone on a high-rise penthouse balcony.

Person · Expression:
Defined facial structure with high cheekbones and a soft jawline. Her eyes are partially closed in a serene, contemplative expression, framed by long dark lashes. Her hair is a deep auburn with golden highlights, styled in thick waves cascading over one shoulder. The skin features a natural, soft texture with subtle pores and light freckles on the shoulders.

Clothing · Pose:
An emerald-green silk satin evening gown with a backless design and thin spaghetti straps. The skirt features high side slits that reveal the movement of the fabric. She is posed in a relaxed weight shift, with one hand resting on an ornate wrought-iron railing and the other holding a crystal champagne flute at chest height. Her head is tilted back slightly, savoring the atmosphere.

Background · Light:
An Art-Deco balcony with polished marble floors overlooking a sparkling city skyline. The scene is illuminated by the golden hour sun positioned behind the subject, creating a pronounced rim-light effect and making the silk appear translucent at the edges. The background transitions into a deep twilight blue sky with antique street lamps glowing below.

Composition · Camera:
A medium-full vertical shot from an eye-level perspective with a slight low-angle tilt. The composition follows the rule of thirds, using a shallow depth of field to maintain sharp focus on the subject and the condensation on the glass while the city becomes a soft, creamy bokeh.

Texture · Style:
Ultra-photorealistic rendering with a focus on material contrast: the cool, reflective marble and wrought iron against the warm, soft texture of the skin and the liquid sheen of the satin gown. The color palette is a rich blend of emerald, gold, amber, and deep evening blues with a vintage cinematic grade.

Highlights are predominantly warm ivory and creamy white, while shadows remain deep but soft and painterly.
The background uses the same desaturated blue-gray and warm ivory palette, appearing like an unfinished classical painted canvas. Broad vertical and horizontal brushstrokes, translucent paint layers, softly scraped areas, subtle dry-brush textures, and irregular painterly patches create an atmospheric studio-like backdrop. Keep the background simple, quiet, and organically integrated with the portrait rather than sharply separated.
The lower portion of the figure intentionally becomes unfinished and gradually dissolves into loose white and ivory brushstrokes. Clothing, shoulders, chest, and lower contours progressively lose definition, breaking into scattered semi-transparent strokes and fading pigment. Edges become incomplete, soft, irregular, and partially disappear into the background, creating the unmistakable impression of an intentionally unfinished oil painting. Do not create a hard bottom edge.

entries.content:
Theme:
A cinematic study of discipline and form in a classic ballet studio during a moment of technical correction.

Subject:
Female ballerina, early 20s, of elegant and athletic build. She stands in a focused rehearsal with her choreographer, whose presence is indicated by a polished shoe precisely positioned between her feet.

Person · Expression:
Refined facial features with porcelain skin showing a subtle sheen under warm light. Eyes are closed or looking downward in deep concentration. A classic ballet bun with a few loose, backlit strands of hair. Subtle muscle definition is visible in the neck and shoulders.

Clothing · Pose:
A form-fitting practice leotard in muted ivory with a soft, tactile fabric that follows the dancer's lean frame. She is poised on pointe shoes, body perfectly vertical and core engaged. The pose captures a moment of perfect alignment and physical tension during a correction.

Background · Light:
A vintage rehearsal studio with dark wood-paneled walls and a large mirror wall. A single warm lamp provides directional key lighting from the side, creating a golden glow and rich, dramatic shadows. A wooden barre is visible in the soft-focus periphery.

Composition · Camera:
Vertical 9:16 framing using a low angle to emphasize height and verticality. An 85mm lens provides subject isolation with a soft bokeh. The composition is centered on the dancer and her reflection, creating a symmetrical balance across the mirror plane.

Texture · Style:
Photorealistic cinematic still with a Rembrandt lighting character. High detail on the fabric textures, wood grain, and the satin sheen of the pointe shoes. Warm color grading with deep, velvety shadows and amber highlights.
